name: get_env_state
description: Return the current internal state of the environment.

name: create_zone
description: Create a new security zone to monitor.

zone_type.description: Type of zone — must be one of: entrance, office, corridor, storage, outdoor, parking.

access_level.description: Access restriction level — public, restricted, private. Defaults to 'public'.

has_door_lock.description: Whether this zone has an electronic door lock that can be controlled remotely. Defaults to False.

name: update_zone
description: Update properties of an existing zone.

name.description: Name of the zone to update.

updates.description: Fields to change. Allowed keys: access_level, has_door_lock.

name: deploy_sensor
description: Deploy a security sensor in a specific zone.

zone_name.description: Name of the zone where sensor will be deployed.

sensor_type.description: Type of sensor — motion, door, window, camera, glass_break, smoke.

location.description: Specific location description within the zone.

name: list_sensors
description: List deployed sensors with optional filtering.

name: update_sensor_status
description: Update the operational status of a sensor.

sensor_id.description: ID of the sensor to update.

trigger_type.description: Event type that triggers evaluation — intrusion_detected, unauthorized_entry, motion_alert, door_forced, window_break, after_hours_activity.

condition_field.description: Field in the event payload to evaluate.

condition_op.description: Comparison operator — eq, neq, gt, lt, gte, lte, contains, matches.

actions.description: Ordered list of actions to execute when condition is met. Each action has 'type' (lock_door, call_police, capture_video, send_sms, sound_alarm, notify_security, activate_lights) and 'params'.

zone_filter.description: [Optional] Only trigger for events in this specific zone.

priority.description: Rule priority level — low, normal, high, critical. Defaults to 'normal'.

name: update_rule
description: Update fields of an existing security rule.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to update.

updates.description: Fields to change. Allowed keys: name, enabled, trigger_type, condition, actions, zone_filter, priority.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to delete.

name: list_rules
description: List all configured security rules with optional filtering.

enabled_only.description: If True, return only enabled rules. Defaults to False.

name: inject_event
description: Inject a simulated security event. The environment evaluates all matching rules

zone_name.description: Name of the zone where the event occurred.

event_type.description: Type of the security event (must match a valid trigger_type).

payload.description: Arbitrary key-value data describing the event (e.g., severity, threat_level, person_count, time_of_day).

sensor_id.description: [Optional] ID of the sensor that detected the event.

limit.description: Maximum events to return. Defaults to 20.

name: get_action_log
description: Retrieve history of executed security actions.

limit.description: Maximum actions to return. Defaults to 50.

name: set_security_status
description: Manually set the overall security status.

status.description: New security status — normal, alert, lockdown.

name: get_security_status
description: Get the current overall security status and zone summary.

name: lock_zone_door
description: Manually lock the door of a specific zone.

zone_name.description: Name of the zone to lock.

name: unlock_zone_door
description: Manually unlock the door of a specific zone.

zone_name.description: Name of the zone to unlock.
